facts: Report period: July to October (the last 4 complete months).
Total revenue for the period: $75.3K. Net profit: $3.1K. Profit margin: 4.1%.
Revenue by month: July $18.6K, August $17.9K, September $20.5K, October $18.2K.
Net profit by month: July $1.0K, August $1.2K, September $0.2K, October $0.8K.
Best month for sales: September at $20.5K, up 14% on August.
Average clean value: $178 across 424 cleans. Quotes won: 43%.
Biggest service type: Regular / Recurring Clean, $32.3K revenue, margin after overheads -4%, labour takes 73c of every dollar.
Strongest service type: Carpet / Window / Deep Clean, margin after overheads 22% (keeps 22c of every dollar).
Cleans cost 12% more than quoted: $5.9K over quote in total, 288 of 424 cleans over budget.
Revenue per paid hour: $55 against a target of $57. 80% of paid time is spent cleaning. Labour is 65% of revenue.
Average monthly sales: $18.8K. Break-even: $17.8K a month. A 6% drop in sales would mean a loss.
